class.name: GodotDoctorCLIValidationReporter
class.brief_description: Validation reporter for headless / CLI mode. Delegates rendering to [GodotDoctorReportPrinter] using report objects built from validation collections. Exits the process with an appropriate code when validation is complete.

method.name: report_on_scene_validation_collection
method.description: No-op override; scene results are reported through [method report_on_validation_suite_collection].

method.name: report_on_resource_validation_collection
method.description: No-op override; resource results are reported through [method report_on_validation_suite_collection].

method.name: report_on_validation_suite_collection
method.description: Generates and prints a full validation report from [param validation_suite_collection]. Also exports a JUnit XML report if configured in settings. Returns [code]true[/code] if all validation passed, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: _create_validation_suite_reports_from_validation_suite_validation_collection
method.description: Builds an array of [GodotDoctorValidationSuiteReport] instances from [param validation_suite_validation_collection].

method.name: _create_scene_reports_from_scene_validation_collection
method.description: Builds an array of [GodotDoctorSceneReport] instances from [param scene_validation_collection].

method.name: _create_resource_reports_from_resource_validation_collection
method.description: Builds an array of [GodotDoctorResourceReport] instances from [param resource_validation_collection].

method.name: _create_node_reports_from_node_validation_collection
method.description: Builds an array of [GodotDoctorNodeReport] instances from [param node_validation_collection].

method.name: _create_validation_suite_report
method.description: Creates a [GodotDoctorValidationSuiteReport] from [param validation_suite], [param scene_reports], and [param resource_reports].

method.name: _create_scene_report
method.description: Creates a [GodotDoctorSceneReport] for [param scene_path] with [param node_reports].

method.name: _create_node_report
method.description: Creates a [GodotDoctorNodeReport] for [param node_ancestor_path] with [param validation_messages].

method.name: _create_resource_report
method.description: Creates a [GodotDoctorResourceReport] for [param resource_path] with [param validation_messages].

method.name: _report_on_scene_validation_collection
method.description: Unused override; scene results are handled at suite level. No-op.

method.name: _report_on_resource_validation_collection
method.description: Unused override; resource results are handled at suite level. No-op.
